description: CoinLoader/BotAppStore: Buy a bot license. method=card (default for BotAppStore / CoinLoader): with confirm=true returns a hosted checkout_url that a human opens to pay by card / Apple Pay / Google Pay. method=sol: this tool never creates a SOL order; it returns the live price preview and the bot's page, where the human completes SOL checkout. site=wattcoin is SOL only (card is rejected). confirm=false (default) only previews the price and creates nothing. Only call with confirm=true after the user agrees to buy.

confirm.description: false (default) = price preview, no order. true = hand off to checkout.

method.description: card (default; not for site=wattcoin) or sol

site.description: botappstore (default), coinloader, or wattcoin (wattcoin.org bots, SOL only)

sku.description: Product or bundle SKU from list_products

storefront.description: Alias of site for botappstore / coinloader

name: start_checkout
